g.aria-label: Token Throughput vs. Time-to-Target-Loss: E(b) = E_min(1 + b / b_noise)
Doubling batch size b halves steps
needed to reach target validation loss
Gradient noise is already averaged out
Larger batches make same step progress
Batch-Preserving Ops (compile, bf16, FlashAttention, strong DP) Always Cut Time-to-Target;
Batch-Enlarging Ops (B=512, weak DP) Help iff b_noise > (512 − 64ρ)/(ρ − 1)
